tasks.text: delivering messages to passengers or clients.

records.title: TRANSPORT NETWORK VEHICLE SERVICE VAN DRIVERS

definition_paragraphs.text: TNVS van drivers drive and tend motor vans to transport passengers, mail or goods. But unlike conventional drivers, TNVS van drivers use a mobile application for booking rides and navigation.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: driving and tending vans;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: booking rides using a mobile application;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: picking up and dropping off goods or passengers at designated locations;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: assisting passengers with handling of luggage;;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: observing traffic rules and signals;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: cleaning and washing vehicle as well as performing maintenance and minor repairs;

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: keeping a record of journeys; and

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: delivering messages to passengers or clients.

definition_paragraphs.text: Heavy truck and bus drivers drive and tend heavy trucks, lorries, buses or street tramcars to transport goods,  liquids, heavy materials, mail or passengers.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed usually include: driving and tending heavy trucks, lorries, buses or street tramcars in order to  transport goods, liquids, heavy materials, mail or passengers.

definition_paragraphs.text: Bus and tram drivers drive and tend buses or street tramcars to transport passengers, mail or goods.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: driving and tending motor bus, trolley bus or motor coach to transport local or long mail or goods;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: driving and tending street tramcar transporting passengers;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: opening and closing doors before or after passengers board or alight;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: assisting passengers with luggage;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: controlling lighting, heating and ventilation on buses and trams;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: observing traffic to ensure safe progress; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: collecting fares or verifying passenger has necessary ticket.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Heavy-truck and lorry drivers drive and tend heavy motor vehicles to transport goods, liquids and heavy  materials over short or long distances.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: driving and tending a heavy motor vehicle, such as a lorry with or without trailer or a dump-truck, to  transport goods, liquids or heavy materials over short or long distances;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: determining the most appropriate routes;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: ensuring goods are stowed and securely covered, to prevent loss and damage;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: assisting with or carrying out loading or unloading operations, using various lifting or tipping devices;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: carrying out minor maintenance to vehicles, and arranges major maintenance and repairs; and

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: estimating weights to comply with load limitations, and ensuring the safe distribution of weights.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Mobile plant operators drive, tend, operate and monitor special -purpose motorized, machinery or equipment  used for clearing or preparing land; digging, moving, and spreading earth, rock and similar materials; and lifting or  moving heavy objects.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed usually include: preparing and positioning plant for operation; adjusting speed, height and  depth of implements; driving and operating mobile plant; operating attachments to lift, swing and release trees,  logs, earth and other heavy objects or materials; operating and monitoring lifting trucks and stationary or mobile cranes in construction, transportation and storage operations; servicing machinery and performing minor  repairs.

records.title: MOBILE FARM AND FORESTRY PLANT OPERATORS

definition_paragraphs.text: Mobile farm and forestry plant operators drive, tend, operate and monitor one or more types of special purpose motorized, mobile machinery or equipment used in agricultural, horticultural and forestry operations.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: driving and tending tractor drawn or self-propelled special -purpose farm machinery to plough land and  sow, fertilize, cultivate and harvest crops;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: driving and tending tractor-drawn or self-propelled special -purpose forestry machinery to clear land, plant,  harvest and carry trees and timber or perform other forestry operations;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: preparing and positioning plant for operation;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: adjusting speed, height and depth of implements;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: operating plant to hold, lift and cut trees;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: operating attachments to lift, swing, release and sort trees and logs, and operating auxiliary plant such as  chipping machines and log splitting machines;

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: feeding felled trees into processors to strip limbs and cut into logs and loading logs onto stockpiles and into trucks; and

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: servicing machinery and performing minor repairs.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Earthmoving and related plant operators operate machines to excavate, grade, level, smooth and compact earth or  similar materials.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: operating and monitoring excavating machinery equipped with moveable shovel, grab-bucket or dragline  bucket, to excavate and move earth, rock, sand, gravel or similar materials;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: operating and monitoring machinery for digging trenches for sewers, drainage, water, oil, gas or similar  pipelines;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: operating and monitoring machinery equipped with concave steel blade to move, distribute and level earth,  sand, snow and other materials;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: operating and monitoring equipment to remove sand, gravel and mud from bottom of body of water;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: operating and monitoring machines for hammering wooden, concrete or steel piles into ground;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: operating and monitoring power roller to compact and smooth layers of materials in making roads,  pavements and similar work; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: operating and monitoring machines which spread and smooth concrete or bituminous or tar preparations to  construct roadways, roads or similar surfaces.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

records.title: CRANE, HOIST AND RELATED PLANT OPERATORS

definition_paragraphs.text: Crane, hoist and related plant operators operate and monitor stationary and mobile cranes and other hoisting  equipment.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: operating and monitoring stationary or mobile cranes by raising and lowering jibs and booms, to lift, move,  position or place equipment and materials;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: operating and monitoring equipment for hoisting, lowering or raising workers and materials on construction  sites or in mines;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: operating and monitoring ski-lifts and similar equipment;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: operating and monitoring machinery used to haul ferry or barge with goods, passengers and vehicles across  short stretches of water;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: operating and monitoring machinery to open and close bridge for the passage of road and water traffic;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: operating and monitoring cranes equipped with dredging attachments to dredge waterways and other areas; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: operating cranes mounted on boats or barges to lift, move and place equipment and materials.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Lifting-truck operators drive, operate and monitor lifting-truck or similar vehicle to transport, lift and stack  pallets with goods.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: operating and monitoring lifting-truck and similar equipment to load and unload, transport, lift and stack  goods and pallets in terminals, harbors, warehouses, factories and other establishments;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: positioning lifting devices under, over, or around loaded pallets, skids and boxes, and securing material or  products for transport to designated areas;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: inspecting equipment to identify wear and damage;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: performing routine maintenance on vehicles and equipment; and

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: keeping records of work undertaken and breakdowns of vehicles.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

records.title: SHIPS' DECK CREWS AND RELATED WORKERS
SHIPS' DECK CREWS AND RELATED WORKERS

definition_paragraphs.text: Ship’s deck crews and related workers carry out deck duties on board ship and similar duties on board other  water-borne craft.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: standing look-out watches at sea and when entering or leaving harbor or other narrow waters;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: steering ship according to instructions;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: handling ropes and wires, and operates mooring equipment;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: maintaining and, in some cases, operating ship’s equipment, cargo gear, rigging, life-saving and firefighting  appliances;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: performing deck and hull cleaning, scraping, painting and other maintenance duties as required; and

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: breaking out, rigging and stowing cargo-handling gear, stationary rigging and running gear.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Elementary occupations involve the performance of simple and routine tasks which may require the use of hand-held tools and considerable physical effort.  Most  occupations in this major group require skills at the first ISCO skill level.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed by workers in elementary occupations usually include:  cleaning, restocking supplies and performing basic maintenance in apartments, houses, kitchens, hotels, offices and other buildings; washing cars and windows; helping in kitchens and performing simple tasks in food preparation; delivering messages or goods; carrying luggage and handling baggage and freight;  stocking vending machines or reading and emptying meters; collecting and sorting refuse; sweeping streets and similar places;  performing various simple farming, fishing, hunting or trapping tasks  performing simple tasks connected with mining, construction and manufacturing including product-sorting; packing and unpacking produce by hand and filling shelves; providing various street services; pedaling or hand-guiding vehicles to transport passengers and goods; driving animal-drawn vehicles or machinery.  Supervision of other workers may be included.

definition_paragraphs.text: Cleaners and helpers perform various tasks in private households, hotels, offices, hospitals and other establishments, as well as in aircraft, trains coaches, trams and similar vehicles, in order to keep the interiors and fixtures clean, and launder and press garments and textiles by hand.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed by workers in this sub-major group usually include: sweeping or vacuum cleaning, washing and polishing floors, furniture and other objects; taking care of linen and bed-making; helping with preparation of meals and cleaning in kitchens;  washing and cleaning cars and windows;  pressing or laundering garments and textiles by hand.

records.title: DOMESTIC, HOTEL AND OFFICE CLEANERS AND HELPERS

definition_paragraphs.text: Domestic, hotel and office cleaners and helpers sweep, vacuum clean, wash, polish, take care of household linen, purchase household supplies; perform various tasks in order to keep clean and tidy the interiors and
fixtures of hotels, offices and other establishments, as well as of aircraft, trains, buses and similar vehicles.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed usually include:  sweeping or vacuum cleaning, washing and polishing floors, furniture and other objects in hotels, offices and other establishments;  making beds, supplying towels, soap and related items;  helping with preparation of meals and washing dishes;  cleaning, disinfecting and deodorizing kitchens, bathrooms and toilets.

definition_paragraphs.text: Domestic cleaners and helpers sweep, vacuum clean, wash and polish, take care of household linen, purchase household supplies, prepare food, serve meals and perform various other domestic duties.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: sweeping, vacuum-cleaning, polishing and washing floors and furniture, or washing windows and other fixtures;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: washing, ironing and mending linen and other textiles;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: washing dishes;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: helping with preparation, cooking and serving of meals and refreshments;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: purchasing food and various other household supplies;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: cleaning, disinfecting and deodorizing kitchens, bathrooms and toilets; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: cleaning windows and other glass surfaces.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

records.title: CLEANERS AND HELPERS IN OFFICES, HOTELS AND OTHER ESTABLISHMENTS

definition_paragraphs.text: Cleaners and helpers in offices, hotels and other establishments perform various cleaning tasks in order to keep clean and tidy the interiors and fixtures of hotels, offices and other establishments, as well as of aircraft, trains, buses and similar vehicles.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: sweeping or vacuum-cleaning, washing and polishing floors, furniture and other fixtures in buildings, coaches, buses, trams, trains and aircraft;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: making beds, cleaning bathrooms, supplying towels, soap and related items;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: cleaning kitchens and generally helping with kitchen work, including dishwashing; and

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: picking up rubbish, emptying garbage containers and taking contents to waste areas to removal.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

records.title: VEHICLE, WINDOW, LAUNDRY AND OTHER HAND CLEANING WORKERS

definition_paragraphs.text: Vehicle, window, laundry and other hand cleaning workers clean windows, showcases or other surfaces of buildings or vehicles and press, launder or dry-clean linen and other textiles by hand.

Tasks usually  include: cleaning, washing and polishing cars; washing windows or other glass surfaces with water or various solutions, drying and polishing them; laundering and pressing linen, clothing, fabrics and similar articles by hand in a laundry or other establishments; cleaning by hand and with chemical solutions clothing, fabrics leather goods and similar articles in dry-cleaning or other establishments.
Hand launderers and pressers launder, press or dry-clean garments, linen and other textiles by hand.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: laundering and pressing linen, clothing, fabrics and similar articles by hand in a laundry or other establishment;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: cleaning, by hand and with chemical solutions, clothing, fabrics, leather goods and similar articles, in a dry-cleaning or other establishment;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: replacing buttons and making minor repairs; and

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: placing articles on shelves and hanging articles for delivery and collection.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Vehicle cleaners, wash, clean and polish vehicles.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: cleaning, washing and polishing cars and other vehicles, by hand or using hand-held power tools;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: vacuuming vehicle interiors and dry cleaning carpets and upholstery;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: applying cleaning agents to remove stains from vehicle exteriors and interiors;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: washing tires and wheel arches and blackening tires;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: washing and polishing vehicle windows; and

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: emptying and cleaning compartments in vehicles.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: washing windows or other glass surfaces  with  water  or various solutions, drying and polishing them;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: using ladders, swinging scaffolds, bosun's chairs, hydraulic bucket trucks and other equipment to reach and clean windows in multi – story buildings; and

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: selecting appropriate cleaning or polishing implement.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: cleaning carpets and upholstered furniture using cleaning machines and their attachments;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: selecting and applying cleaning agents to remove stains from carpets;

tasks.label: c

tasks.label: d

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: applying chemicals and high pressure cleaning methods to remove micro-organisms from water and filtration systems and using wet vacuums and other suction equipment to remove scale, accumulated dirt and other deposits from swimming pools, cooling tower components and drains.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Agricultural, forestry and fishery laborers perform simple and routine tasks in the production of crops and livestock,  cultivation and maintenance of gardens and parks,  exploitation and conservation of forests, and conduct of aquaculture and fisheries operations.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed usually include: digging, raking and shoveling using hand tools;  loading, unloading and stacking supplies, produce and other materials; watering, thinning, weeding and tending crops by hand or using hand tools; planting, harvesting picking and collecting produce  by hand; feeding, watering, and cleaning animals and keeping their quarters clean; monitoring livestock, reporting on their condition; preparing and operating nets, lines and other fishing tackle and deck equipment; grading, sorting, bunching and packing produce into containers; performing minor repairs on fixtures, buildings equipment, vessels and fences.

definition_paragraphs.text: Agricultural, forestry and fishery laborers perform simple and routine tasks in the production of crops and livestock,  cultivation and maintenance of gardens and parks,  exploitation and conservation of forests, and conduct of aquaculture and fisheries operations.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed usually include: digging, raking and shoveling using hand tools;  loading unloading and stacking supplies, produce and other materials; watering, thinning, weeding and tending crops by hand or using hand tools; planting, harvesting picking and collecting produce  by hand; feeding, watering, and cleaning animals and keeping their quarters clean; monitoring livestock, reporting on their condition; preparing and operating nets, lines and other fishing tackle and deck equipment; grading, sorting, bunching and packing produce into containers; performing minor repairs on fixtures, buildings equipment, vessels and fences.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: digging and shoveling to clear ditches or for other purposes;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: loading and unloading supplies, produce and other materials;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: raking, pitching and stacking straw, hay and similar material;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: watering, thinning, and weeding crops by hand or using hand tools;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: picking fruit, nuts, vegetables and other crops;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: planting and harvesting field crops, such as rice, by hand;

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: grading, sorting, bunching and packing produce into containers; and

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: performing minor repairs on fixtures, buildings and fences.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

tasks.text: digging and shoveling to clear ditches or for other purposes;

tasks.label: b

tasks.text: feeding, watering, and cleaning animals and keeping their quarters clean;

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: raking, pitching, stacking and storing hay, straw and other types of animal feed and bedding grading, sorting, packing produce into containers; and

tasks.label: i
tasks.text: performing minor repairs on fixtures, buildings and fences.

records.title: MIXED CROP AND LIVESTOCK FARM LABORERS

tasks.text: digging and shoveling to clear ditches or for other purposes;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: loading and unloading supplies, produce and other materials;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: raking, pitching and stacking straw, hay and similar material;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: watering, thinning, and weeding crops by hand or using hand tools;

tasks.label: e

tasks.text: planting and harvesting field crops, such as rice, by hand;

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: feeding, watering, and cleaning animals and keeping their quarters clean;

tasks.text: monitoring livestock, reporting on their condition;

tasks.label: i
tasks.text: assisting with herding, droving and separating livestock for milking, shearing, transportation or slaughter and between pastures;

tasks.text: grading, sorting, bunching and packing produce into containers; and

tasks.text: performing minor repairs on fixtures, buildings and fences.

tasks.text: loading, unloading and moving supplies, produce and equipment;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: preparing garden sites and plots using hand tools and simple machines;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: assisting with planting and transplanting flowers, shrubs, trees and lawns;

tasks.text: cleaning gardens and removing rubbish;

tasks.text: tending plants by hand watering and weeding;

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: harvesting and packaging plants for sale and transport; and

tasks.text: performing minor repairs on fixtures, buildings and fences.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: digging holes for tree planting;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: stacking and loading logs and timber;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: clearing undergrowth in forest stands and thinning young plantations;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: maintaining look-out for fires in forests;

tasks.label: g

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: cleaning the sea-bed and feeding fish and mollusks that are being cultivated;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: gathering seaweed, sea mosses, clams and other mollusks;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: preparing nets, lines and other fishing tackle and other deck equipment;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: operating fishing gear to catch fish and other marine life;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: cleaning, sorting and packing fish and seafood in ice and salt and stowing catch in hold;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: cleaning deck surfaces and fish hold; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: handling mooring lines during docking.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

records.title: LABORERS IN MINING, CONSTRUCTION, MANUFACTURING AND TRANSPORT

definition_paragraphs.text: Laborers in mining, construction, manufacturing and transport perform simple and routine manual tasks in mining, quarrying, civil engineering, building, manufacturing, transport and storage operations, and operate human powered and animal drawn vehicles and machinery.

Task performed by workers in this sub-major group usually include: digging holes and spreading excavated materials, sand, soil, and gravel using hand-held tools; sorting, loading, unloading, moving stacking and storing materials, equipment, products, supplies, baggage and cargo by hand;  cleaning machinery, equipment, tools and work sites; packing and unpacking material and products and filling containers and shelves with products by hand; operating human powered and animal drawn vehicles and machinery.
Mining and construction laborers perform simple and routine manual tasks in mining, quarrying, civil engineering and building operations.

Tasks usually include:  digging and filling holes and trenches using hand held tools; shoveling and spreading excavated materials, sand, soil, and gravel; sorting, loading, unloading, stacking and storing tools, materials and equipment and transporting them around work sites;  cleaning machinery, equipment, tools and work sites and removing obstructions.
Mining and quarrying laborers perform routine tasks in mining and quarrying operations.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: assisting miners and quarriers in maintaining machinery, equipment, and mine and quarry installations;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: assembling and dismantling mining equipment;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: removing tunnel supports from disused workings in mines and quarries;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: removing dangerous projections from mine and quarry workings;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: removing waste and serviceable materials and equipment from work areas after extraction activities have been completed, and clearing rock and mineral spills;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: cleaning machinery, equipment, tools, roadways and haulage tracks; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: sorting, loading, unloading, stacking and storing tools, materials and supplies used by other mine workers.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: digging and filling holes and trenches using hand held tools;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: shoveling and spreading gravel and related materials;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: trimming and cutting rocks and concrete and bitumen surfaces using jack-hammers;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: loading and unloading construction materials, excavated material and equipment and transporting them around construction sites using wheelbarrows and hand trucks; and

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: cleaning worksites and removing obstructions.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Building construction laborers perform routine tasks in connection with building construction and demolition work.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: cleaning used building bricks and doing other simple work on demolition sites;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: mixing pouring and spreading materials such as concrete, plaster and mortar digging and filling holes and trenches using hand held tools;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: spreading sand, soil, gravel and similar materials;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: loading and unloading construction materials, excavated material and equipment and transporting them around construction sites using wheelbarrows, hods and hand trucks; and

tasks.text: cleaning work sites and removing obstructions.

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: filling bottles, cans, boxes, bags and other containers with products by hand; and

tasks.text: loading and unloading vehicles, trucks and trolleys;

tasks.label: c

tasks.text: collecting fares or charges.

tasks.text: collecting fares or charges;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: driving animals to haul wagons in mines or quarries;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: driving animals hitched to farm or other machinery;

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: driving working animals;

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: maintaining vehicle or machinery, making minor repairs and installing replacement parts; and

tasks.label: i
tasks.text: grooming and feeding animals.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Freight handlers carry out tasks such as packing, carrying, loading and unloading furniture and other household items, or loading and unloading ship and aircraft cargoes and other freight, or carrying and stacking goods in various warehouses.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: carrying goods to be loaded on or unloaded from vans, trucks, wagons, ships, or aircraft;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: loading and unloading grain, coal, sand and similar goods by placing them on conveyor-belts, pipes, etc.;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: connecting hoses between main shore installation pipes and tanks of barges, tankers and other ships to load and unload petroleum, liquefied gases and other liquids;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: carrying and stacking goods in warehouses and similar establishments; and

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: sorting cargo prior to loading and unloading.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Shelf fillers stock shelves and display areas and keep stock clean and in order in supermarkets and other retail and wholesale shops.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: placing goods neatly in bins and on racks, and stacking bulky goods on floors;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: filling shelves with goods ensuring goods with the earliest use-by dates are at the front of shelves;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: removing goods with past due use-by dates;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: maintaining shelf order by removing stock belonging in a different location;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: noting what has been sold and collecting goods needed from the stockroom;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: obtaining articles for customers from shelf or stockroom;

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: directing customers to location of articles sought; and

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: receiving, opening, unpacking, and inspecting for damage merchandise from manufacturer or distributor.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

records.title: TRANSPORT NETWORK VEHICLE SERVICE BICYCLE DRIVERS

definition_paragraphs.text: TNVS bicycle drivers propel cycles and similar vehicles to transport goods.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: driving and tending bicycles;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: booking rides using a mobile application;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: picking up and dropping off goods at designated locations;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: observing traffic rules and signals;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: cleaning and washing vehicle as well as performing maintenance and minor repairs;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: keeping a record of journeys; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: delivering messages to passengers or clients.

definition_paragraphs.text: Food preparation assistants prepare and cook to order a small variety of pre-cooked food or beverages, clear tables, clean kitchen areas and wash dishes.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed by workers usually include: preparing simple or pre-prepared foods and beverages such as sandwiches, pizzas, fish and chips, salads, and coffee; washing, cutting, measuring and mixing foods for cooking; operating cooking equipment such as grills, microwaves and deep-fat fryers; cleaning kitchens, food preparation areas and service areas; cleaning cooking and general utensils used in kitchens and restaurants.

definition_paragraphs.text: Fast food preparers prepare and cook to order a  limited range of foods or beverages that involve simple preparation processes and a small number of ingredients. They may take orders from customers and serve at counters or tables.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: preparing simple or pre-prepared foods and beverages such as sandwiches, hamburgers, pizzas, fish and chips, salads, and coffee;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: washing, cutting, measuring and mixing foods for cooking;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: operating large-volume single-process cooking equipment such as grills, deep-fat fryers or griddles;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: re-heating pre-prepared food, cleaning food preparation areas, cooking surfaces and utensils;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: taking and serving food and beverage orders in eating places that specialize in fast service and carry-out food;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: ordering and taking delivery of fast food ingredients;

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: maintaining sanitation, health, and safety standards in work areas;

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: operating large-volume cooking equipment such as grills, deep-fat fryers, or griddles; and

tasks.label: i
tasks.text: verifying that prepared food meets requirements for quality and quantity.

definition_paragraphs.text: Kitchen helpers clear tables, clean kitchen areas, wash dishes, preparing ingredients and perform other duties to assist workers who prepare or serve food and beverages.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: cleaning kitchens, food preparation areas and service areas;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: assisting cooks and chefs in preparation of food by washing, peeling, chopping, cutting up, measuring and mixing ingredients;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: assembling dishes for service;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: unpacking and storing supplies in refrigerators, cupboards and other storage areas;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: washing dishes and cooking utensils and putting them away;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: checking, transferring, weighing and storing supplies in refrigerators, cupboards and other storage areas; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: preparing, cooking, toasting and heating simple food items.

records.title: STREET AND RELATED SALES AND SERVICE WORKERS

definition_paragraphs.text: Street and related sales and service workers provide sell goods, excluding food for immediate consumptions, and provide a variety of services on streets and in other public places such as stations.

Tasks include:  buying or making various items for sale; loading and unloading items for sale and transporting them; obtaining the materials necessary to perform services; approaching people on the street to offer goods or services; cleaning and polishing shoes; cleaning and polishing car windows; running errands; assisting drivers to find a parking place and ensuring car is not damaged during driver’s absence; handing out leaflets and free newspapers; receiving immediate payment.

Street and related service workers provide a variety of services on streets and in other public places, including cleaning shoes, washing car windows, running errands, looking after property, and providing other on-the-spot street services.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: obtaining the materials necessary to perform services;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: approaching people on the street to offer services;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: cleaning and polishing shoes;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: cleaning and polishing car windows;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: running errands;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: assisting drivers to find a parking place and ensuring car is not damaged during driver’s absence;

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: handing out leaflets and free newspapers; and

tasks.label: h
tasks.text: receiving immediate payment.

definition_paragraphs.text: Street vendors (excluding food) sell a usually limited range of goods (excluding food for immediate consumption) in streets and public places such as stations, cinemas or theatres.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: buying or receiving items for sale, or making simple items;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: loading and unloading basket, tray, push-cart, bicycle, hand truck or other vehicle, to transport goods to the streets or public places such as stations or cinemas;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: displaying goods or calling out to attract customer’s attention;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: approaching potential customers on street and offering goods for sale; and

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: receiving immediate payment.

records.title: REFUSE WORKERS AND OTHER ELEMENTARY WORKERS

definition_paragraphs.text: Refuse workers and other elementary workers collect garbage from buildings, yards, streets and other public places or keep streets and other public places or perform odd jobs for private households or establishments.

Tasks include: collecting, loading and unloading garbage; sweeping streets, parks and other public places; chopping firewood; carrying water;  beating dust out of carpets and performing other odd-job tasks.
Refuse workers collect, process and recycle garbage from buildings, yards, streets and other public places, or keep streets and other public places clean.
Tasks usually include: collecting, loading and unloading garbage; sweeping streets, parks and other public places; sorting and recycling garbage such as paper, glass, plastic or aluminum.
Garbage collectors collect and remove rubbish and items for recycling from buildings, yards, streets and other places.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: collecting rubbish and recyclable materials and locating it into bins and garbage and recycling trucks;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: riding on or in garbage and recycling trucks;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: lifting garbage bins and emptying contents into trucks and larger containers; and

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: unloading garbage and recycling trucks.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Refuse sorters identify, collect and sort discarded items suitable for recycling at dump sites and recycling enterprises or in buildings, streets and other public places.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: searching through refuse and collecting items for recycling from dump sites, domestic, commercial and industrial premises or from public places such as streets;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: sorting cardboard, paper, glass, plastic, aluminum or other recyclable materials by type;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: placing recyclable items and materials in designated compartments and containers for storage or transportation;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: identifying and setting aside items of furniture, equipment, machinery, or components that are suitable for repair or re-use;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: transporting recyclable items by hand or using non-motorized vehicles; and

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: selling recyclable or reusable materials.

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: beating dust out of carpets by using a carpet-beater; and

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: cleaning rubbish, leaves from driveways and grounds.

section_markers.text: Examples of the occupations classified here:

definition_paragraphs.text: Other elementary workers deliver and carry messages and packages, collect money and stock vending machines, read meters, collect water and firewood, collect and issue tickets for parking or events.

task_summary_paragraphs.text: Tasks performed usually include: chopping wood, collecting water and firewood; delivering messages, packages and other items within or between establishments, or elsewhere; performing duties as a post-runner; issuing and collecting tickets and passes; calculating parking charges; filling storage areas of vending machines and collecting money from containers; reading electricity, gas or water meters and recording consumption.

records.title: MESSENGERS, PACKAGE DELIVERERS AND LUGGAGE PORTERS

definition_paragraphs.text: Messengers, package deliverers and luggage porters carry and deliver messages, packages and other items within an establishment or between establishments, to households and elsewhere, or carry luggage especially at hotels, stations and airports.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: delivering messages, packages and other items within an establishment or between establishments, or elsewhere;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: performing the duties of a post-runner;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: delivering various goods to and from enterprises, shops, households and other places;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: carrying and delivering luggage at hotels, stations, airports, and elsewhere;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: receiving and marking baggage by completing attaching claim checks;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: planning and following the most efficient route; and

tasks.label: g
tasks.text: sorting items to be delivered according to the delivery route.

definition_paragraphs.text: Odd job persons clean, paint and maintain buildings, grounds and facilities, and undertake simple repairs.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: repairing broken windows, screens, doors, fences, barbecues, picnic tables, shelves, cupboards and other items;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: replacing defective items such as light bulbs;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: repairing and painting interior and exterior surfaces such as walls, ceilings and fences;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: adjusting doors and windows;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: replacing tap washers;

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: putting up handrails and grab rails; and

tasks.label: g

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: collecting money from parking meters and similar coin-boxes;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: reading electricity, gas or water meters and recording consumption;

tasks.label: d

tasks.label: e

tasks.label: f

tasks.label: g

definition_paragraphs.text: Water and firewood collectors collect water and firewood and transport them on foot or using hand or animal carts.

tasks.label: a
tasks.text: cutting and collecting wood from forests for sale in market or as fuel or for own consumption;

tasks.label: b
tasks.text: visiting forests or fields to pick pieces of dried wood from ground and arranging them in heaps;

tasks.label: c
tasks.text: cutting decayed branches and trunks of trees using axe and hand -saw;

tasks.label: d
tasks.text: tying collected wood into small faggots and carrying them or transporting them on a cart to the market for sale or to village or household for use;

tasks.label: e
tasks.text: drawing water from wells, rivers or ponds etc. for domestic use; and

tasks.label: f
tasks.text: collecting water in leather bags, buckets or other containers from taps, rivers, ponds or wells and delivering the water to work sites, the houses of clients or to own household for drinking, cleaning of drains or storage in tanks.
